name: SKYRIM
info: SKYRIM IS THE HARSH, MAJESTIC NORTHERN PROVINCE OF TAMRIEL AND HOME TO THE NORDS. FAMOUS FOR ITS SNOWY PEAKS, DENSE FORESTS, AND ANCIENT DRAGON RUINS, IT IS A LEGENDARY LAND OF EPIC ADVENTURE AND RUGGED BEAUTY

solitude.title: solitude
solitude.subtitle: haafigar
solitude.desc: the capital of skyrim and seat of the high king, majestically perched on a giant rock arch above the sea of ghosts. it is the wealthiest and most cosmopolitan city in the province.

dawnstar.title: dawnstar
dawnstar.subtitle: the pale
dawnstar.desc: a freezing, wind-swept port town on the northern coast, built around bustling iron and quicksilver mines. known for its bitter polar cold, restless fishermen, and mysterious nightmares.

winterhold.title: winterhold
winterhold.subtitle: winterhold hold
winterhold.desc: a desolate, ruined cliffside town perched precariously over the icy sea of ghosts, once the grand capital of skyrim. today, it is a haunting reminder of past glory.

morthal.title: morthal
morthal.subtitle: hjaalmarch
morthal.desc: a gloomy, isolated town built among the misty and treacherous marshes of the northern lowlands. constantly shrouded in thick fog, it is a quiet, eerie settlement.

windhelm.title: windhelm
windhelm.subtitle: eastmarch
windhelm.desc: the ancient, snow-swept city of stone founded by ysgramor himself, serving as the formidable capital of the stormcloak rebellion. it features massive imperial architecture.

markarth.title: markarth
markarth.subtitle: the reach
markarth.desc: a formidable fortress-city carved entirely from ancient dwemer stone into the sheer rock walls of a mountain gorge. it is a grim and rugged capital plagued by silver-mine unrest.

whiterun.title: whiterun
whiterun.subtitle: whiterun hold
whiterun.desc: a bustling trading hub and the spiritual heart of skyrim, built upon a massive rock outcropping in the center of the tundra. it is divided into distinct tiers culminating in dragonsreach.

falkreath.title: falkreath
falkreath.subtitle: falkreath hold
falkreath.desc: a quiet, somber town nestled deep within dense, perpetually shadowed pine forests and surrounded by massive ancient graveyards where death is a constant neighbor.

riften.title: riften
riften.subtitle: the rift
riften.desc: a colorful yet deeply corrupt autumn-hued port city ruled from the shadows by the thieves guild and the black-briar family, nestled among golden forests and shimmering lakes.
